messages.subject: bym2 in survival models
parts:
Hello,

Is it possible to use 'bym2' with a survival model? I'm using the developmental version of INLA (0.0- 1485844051), but my code (below) crashes.

formula6<-inla.surv(time,cens)~ 1 + f(id, model = "bym2", graph =qld, scale.model = TRUE, constr = TRUE,
 hyper = list(
  phi = list(
    prior = "pc",
    param = c(0.5, 0.667),
    initial = -3),
  prec = list(
     prior = "pc.prec",
     param = c(0.645, 0.01) ,
     initial = 5)))

r6<-inla(formula6, family="weibullsurv", data=mydata.surv, control.compute=list(cpo=TRUE, dic=TRUE), debug = inla.getOption("debug"), verbose=TRUE)

Unfortunately I am too new to INLA to make sense of the verbose output generated prior to crashing, but the warning message afterwards is:
Warning message:
running command '"C:/Users/.../bin/windows/64bit/inla.exe"  -b -s -v  "C:/Users/.../Model.ini"' had status 5


Thanks very much for your help.

Warmly,
Susanna
